text.content:
Small, neutral, and selling to everyone.

Headquarters: A tower on the Corporate Plaza ring
Industry: Computer hardware and cyberdecks, avionics and AVs, drones and robotics, medical gear and cryotanks
Known for: Strict neutrality: its drones fight on both sides of a war

Zetatech began as the smallest of the megacorps, designing computer hardware. Its size kept it out of the worst of the 4th Corporate War, and it used that head start to move into avionics, AVs, drones and robotics. In Night City it sells hardware, cyberdecks, medical gear and cryotanks.

It sells to anyone, so it isn't unusual to find Zetatech drones on both sides of the same battle.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.24; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.05, 07
